cliHelp.usage: Run without arguments to start normally - usually not by hand, but automatically.
cliHelp.description.service: Local DoH quorum filter - listens on 127.0.0.1, normally started automatically by dnsqb-watcher, not by hand.
cliHelp.description.tray: Tray icon - shows filtering status and gives access to settings; normally started automatically by dnsqb-watcher.
cliHelp.description.watcher: The watchdog process and autostart entry point - supervises dnsqb-service, restarts it if needed, and starts dnsqb-tray.
